messages.name: New sign-in
messages.description: Sent after every sign-in, so people notice one that was not theirs.
messages.recipients: The account that signed in (Sign-in e-mail settings, and each person's own choice)

default.subject: New sign-in to your Sudoo.sh account
default.title: New sign-in
default.body:
Hello {{ name }},

Your account just signed in to Sudoo.sh.

{{ sign_in }}

If this was you, there is nothing to do.

> Not you? Change your password now: it signs out every other session. You can also sign out everywhere from your account page.

[Open your account]({{ account_link }})

{{ opt_out }}
